_note: The 15-week plan to the Winter Showcase (js/season15.js; the printed Sofia-Practice-Toolkit.pdf page 1–2). Weeks run Monday to Sunday from `start`. fri = the Friday focus line; tricks = trick numbers from `ladder` (data/skills.json solo skills carry the same `ladder` numbers); weakest = the weakest trick that week. Until `memoryKneesUntil` the trick card says Memory + knees: no new tricks. A checkpoint with `rehearsal` is dated by the next booked solo rehearsal after `after`.
